name: G4 Real-Task Unrelated Dual Live
suiteRoleNote: Single unrelated real task mirrored across LongCat 2 and DeepSeek v4 Flash so execution flow can be compared without repository-specific context.

cases.title: G4 Unrelated Dual Live: Incident RCA - LongCat 2 Short 64k
cases.taskGoal: Produce a root cause analysis report for a production latency spike in a distributed payment processing system, including timeline reconstruction, contributing factors analysis, and actionable remediation recommendations.
cases.currentObjective: Deliver a complete RCA report with clear root cause identification and remediations.

currentContext.title: incident scenario
currentContext.content: At 2026-05-20T14:32:00Z, the payment-gateway service experienced a P99 latency spike from 200ms to 8500ms lasting 47 minutes. During this window, 12% of checkout transactions timed out. The system comprises payment-gateway (Go), order-service (Java), inventory-service (Rust), and a shared PostgreSQL cluster with read replicas. A deployment of inventory-service v3.7.2 occurred at 14:15:00Z introducing a new database index migration.

currentContext.title: observed signals
currentContext.content: Additional observed signals: database write latency climbed from 18ms to 3.4s by 14:34:00Z; connection pool saturation on order-service rose above 95%; read-replica lag peaked at 18 seconds; inventory-service error rate stayed low but its migration held a lock on inventory_reservations for 11 minutes; rollback of v3.7.2 began at 15:02:00Z and latency returned to baseline by 15:19:00Z.

currentContext.title: delivery contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is disabled. Produce a complete root cause analysis report in Markdown. The report must identify the root cause and provide actionable remediation steps. After the main report, append a formal delivery footer with exactly these headings: ## 结果, ## 证据, ## 风险, ## 已知问题.

acceptanceRejectPhrases: 我会先总结当前局势，再给出最稳妥的下一步
cases.responseRequirements: Produce a complete root cause analysis report in Markdown. The report must identify the root cause and provide actionable remediation steps. After the main report, append a formal delivery footer with exactly these headings: ## 结果, ## 证据, ## 风险, ## 已知问题. Output Markdown only. Do not emit XML tags, tool tags, MCP tags, or planning preambles.
cases.restartMessage: Window restart: continue producing the root cause analysis report. Include root cause identification, remediation steps, and the formal delivery footer with ## 结果, ## 证据, ## 风险, ## 已知问题. Output Markdown only.
